title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.35348v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by maximizing the likelihood of empirical data while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI-FT achieves better density and score metrics than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over i

translated_title: 从数据到程序：从经验数据快速直接地推断生成程序
translated_abstract: 从有限样本集合中估计概率密度通常需要针对特定数据集进行模型拟合。我们提出PRODiGI，这是一个预训练的数据到程序模型，能够在单次前向传播中推断出显式、可执行的生成程序。PRODiGI在合成数据集与其真实程序的配对数据上进行预训练，通过模板预测和非自回归的程序参数解码，能够适应多种生成模型族和数据维度。其推断出的程序支持直接采样、密度与分数评估以及程序检查，且独立于预训练模型运行。我们进一步引入了程序空间微调方法，在保持模型参数不变的前提下，通过最大化经验数据似然来优化可微的程序参数。实验表明，PRODiGI-FT比现有预训练模型取得了更优的密度和分数指标，同时相比迭代方法提供了数倍的加速。
tldr: PRODiGI是一种预训练的数据到程序模型，能在单次前向传播中从经验数据直接推断出显式可执行的生成程序，配合程序空间微调在密度和分数估计上超越现有预训练模型并获得数倍加速。
en_tdlr: PRODiGI is a pretrained data-to-program model that infers explicit, executable generative programs from empirical data in a single forward pass, and with program-space fine-tuning achieves better density and score metrics than existing pretrained models while offering multi-fold speedups.
